description: The line plot illustrates the loss values across iterations for various models, including Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis shows the loss, scaled from 2.4 to 3.4. Initially, all models exhibit a sharp decline in loss, with the Vanilla model showing the highest initial loss, starting near 3.4. As iterations progress, the loss for all models decreases and then stabilizes. The SepLLM (n=128) model demonstrates the lowest loss, plateauing around 2.5, while the Vanilla model stabilizes at a higher loss value, around 2.6. The other models, including StrmLLM (n=64) and SepLLM variants, follow intermediate trajectories, with SepLLM (n=64, H/T) showing a slightly lower loss compared to SepLLM (n=64). The plot highlights the effectiveness of the SepLLM approach in reducing loss more efficiently compared to the Vanilla and StrmLLM models.
